campaigns.name: Icebound
campaigns.summary: An Antarctic-like survival campaign set in the freezing, treacherous peaks of northern Avantris.

campaigns.name: Curse of Strahdanya
campaigns.summary: A dark gothic horror campaign set in the mist-shrouded valley of Barovia, featuring a gender-swapped Countess Strahdanya.

campaigns.name: Beneath Dark Wings
campaigns.summary: A high-stakes dark fantasy campaign exploring the skies, airships, and hidden threats of Avantris.

campaigns.name: Shroud Over Saltmarsh
campaigns.summary: A maritime campaign set in the port town of Saltmarsh, featuring smuggling rings and dark oceanic horrors.

campaigns.name: Edge of Midnight
campaigns.summary: A gritty fantasy campaign set in a realm of eternal night, steam, and folk horror.

campaigns.name: Once Upon a Witchlight
campaigns.summary: A whimsical, chaotic D&D 5e campaign following the Carnivàle Lecroux through the Feywild plane of Prismeer.

campaigns.name: Prime
campaigns.summary: The central campaign in the present day, anchoring the timeline of the continent of Avantris.

campaigns.name: Uprooted
campaigns.summary: A woodland adventure detailing small animal vagabonds navigating forest politics, ruins, and predator factions.

campaigns.name: Stardust Rhapsody
campaigns.summary: A comedic space-opera campaign featuring the crew of the Rhapsody navigating cosmic empires.

campaigns.name: Neon Odyssey
campaigns.summary: A cyberpunk space odyssey featuring massive corporate wars and the resistance against the Bloodfleet.

characters.name: Rowland Stonebridge
characters.background: The young cabin boy of the More Abound and son of Captain Vermeil. He fled after discovering the crew resorted to cannibalism.
characters.quote: They... they aren't eating salt pork anymore. Please don't go near the galley...

characters.name: Fenten Armstead
characters.background: The loyal human boatswain of the More Abound and owner of the orange cat Fiesta, slain during the ship mutiny.
characters.quote: Keep the rigging tight! Fiesta, get down from the mast!

characters.name: Fiesta the Cat
characters.background: An orange cat with green eyes belonging to Bosun Fenten Armstead, acting as the ship's beloved mascot.
characters.quote: *Meow* (Fiesta stares into the frozen blizzard, tail twitching)

characters.name: Walker Clemons
characters.background: A crewman aboard the More Abound who led the cannibalistic mutiny, eventually transforming into a monstrous Herald of Fear.
characters.quote: The meat... it stays fresh in the frost. It's the only way we survive.

characters.name: The Princess of Wrath
characters.background: The ancient white dragon ruler of Drakkar who destroyed the More Abound and terrorizes Argentholme.
characters.quote: Drakkar is mine. Your ship, your bones, and your souls are now frozen artifacts in my gallery.

characters.name: Peggy Flyler (Penny)
characters.background: A chaotic, madcap frog wizard from the Dimwood who channels Divination portents.
characters.quote: The cards do not lie! Or maybe they do, but I like the colors!

characters.name: Barnabos the Dreadwake
characters.background: An aquatic warrior adapted to subzero ocean currents. Barnabos sprouts claws and fangs when he rages under the glacial ice.
characters.quote: The ice does not care for your warmth. Only steel and bone endure.

characters.name: Jornir
characters.background: A giant-kin who channels the freezing winds and frozen pine spirits to help the shipwrecked crew survive Drakkar.
characters.quote: The spirits of the frozen forest whisper to us in the blizzard.

characters.name: Queenie March
characters.background: The party's scout, fleet-footed and adept at tracking game across the frozen, barren tundra.
characters.quote: Stay close, and walk in my footprints. The drifts are deep.

characters.name: Skrimm Stabbaskotch
characters.background: A mischievous goblin who hears whispers from an ancient god frozen deep inside a glacial crevasse.
characters.quote: It speaks to me from under the blue ice. It says we must dig!

characters.name: Taishen Fireblossom
characters.background: A warm-blooded sorcerer whose fire magic is the only thing keeping the party from freezing to death during blizzard nights.
characters.quote: Gather round the flame, or the frost will claim your bones before dawn.

characters.name: Captain Vermeil
characters.background: The grizzled, stern captain of the merchant ship More Abound who commands the survivors after they crash on Drakkar.
characters.quote: This crew survives together, or we freeze in isolation.

characters.name: Professor Clayton Azran
characters.background: An eccentric academic scholar who led the expedition into the foggy valleys of Barovia. Prof. Azran uses divination spells to study planar rifts.
characters.quote: Fascinating... the planar weave here is warped beyond recognition.

characters.name: Victoria Isaacs
characters.background: A mysterious woman born under the influence of the Shadowfell, whose magic lets her slip through mists and command shadow hounds.
characters.quote: The mists are my ally; they bend to my shadow.

characters.name: Kana Soyokaze
characters.background: A disciplined warrior who swore an oath of loyalty to protect Professor Azran's expedition at all costs.
characters.quote: My blade is sworn to the Professor, and my shield to this expedition.

characters.name: Sarnax of the Edelwood
characters.background: A vegetative sorcerer whose woody flesh is decaying due to the dark corrupting energies of Barovian soil.
characters.quote: My leaves are falling, but the roots still run deep in this dark earth.

characters.name: Countess Strahdanya von Zarovich
characters.background: The vampire ruler of Barovia. A gender-swapped, tyrannical countess who toys with the party's minds from her castle ravenloft.
characters.quote: Welcome to my valley. You will find that escape is... a relative term.

characters.name: Toa Kamanui
characters.background: A towering goliath barbarian sailing the sky lanes. Bound to the spirits of his ancestors, Toa fights to defend his airship crew.
characters.quote: My ancestors watch us from the clouds! Do not make them laugh at you.

characters.name: Iris of the Sands
characters.background: A highly capable Tabaxi navigation specialist and cleric, steering the Kestrel through storms.
characters.quote: The stars do not lie, and neither does my compass.

characters.name: Felix Ackerman
characters.background: A sky-faring wizard specializing in aerial flight runes and storm manipulation spell matrices.
characters.quote: Runes in the air, magic in the wind. Hold onto the rigging!

characters.name: Lufti
characters.background: An agile air genasi monk who performs acrobatics in the rigging of the Kestrel.
characters.quote: The wind holds me up. Gravity is just a recommendation.

characters.name: Paladin Poros of Malthea
characters.background: A glorious aasimar paladin serving aboard the Azure Maiden. Poros seeks legendary deeds in the coastal port of Saltmarsh.
characters.quote: Let my halo illuminate the dark ocean trenches!

characters.name: Monty Crumb
characters.background: The sneaky, cook-turned-thief of the ship Azure Maiden who is always looking for lost gold coins.
characters.quote: A pinch of salt in the stew, and a pinch of gold in my pocket.

characters.name: Kaiyo Pearlfin
characters.background: A defender of the deep sea ecosystems who fights smuggler rings polluting the coastal waters of Saltmarsh.
characters.quote: The sea remembers every drop of poison we pour into it.

characters.name: Lethica Nightborne
characters.background: A sombre, dedicated investigator who seeks to purge the curses plagueing the steam-filled lands of Druskenvald.
characters.quote: The mists do not hide the shadows; they are the shadows.

characters.name: Jericho Sticks
characters.background: An animated scarecrow bard bound to crop magic. Jericho gathers the secrets of the dead to power his haunting songs.
characters.quote: I am made of straw, but my words are heavy as lead.

characters.name: Briggsy Kratch
characters.background: A walking corpse bound by a curse of bad luck. Briggsy made a deal at a planar crossroads to prolong his decay.
characters.quote: I'm already dead, mate. The worst that can happen is I fall apart.

characters.name: Marius Renathyr
characters.background: A lethal stalker of the night who balances vampiric urges with protecting mortal villages in Druskenvald.
characters.quote: Blood calls to blood, but steel calls to beasts.

characters.name: Farryn of the Hartsblight
characters.background: A corrupted woodland guide who tracks beasts that cross from the Feywild boundaries into Druskenvald.
characters.quote: The trees tell tales of teeth in the dark.

characters.name: Yorgrim
characters.background: A rugged miner who survived an encounter in the haunted deeps of the Skitterdeep Mine.
characters.quote: Mine deep enough, and you will eventually hit something that bites back.

characters.name: Kremy Lecroux
characters.background: The charismatic, smooth-talking ringleader of the Carnivàle Lecroux. Kremy makes bargains with the dead and utilizes voodoo-inspired magic.
characters.quote: Ah, my lovely friends, welcome to Carnivàle Lecroux! Step inside, don't mind the teeth.

characters.name: Gideon Coal
characters.background: The powerhouse muscle of the Carnivàle Lecroux. Gideon is a fire genasi with a blazing temper who fights with heavy metal chains.
characters.quote: If it breathes, I can punch it. If it doesn't breathe, I can punch it harder.

characters.name: Gricko Grimgrin
characters.background: An illiterate, hyperactive goblin druid who wildshapes into various swamp critters and was once comically crowned frog monarch.
characters.quote: Hootsie, look! A shiny rock! Can we eat it? Let's eat it.

characters.name: Morning Frost
characters.background: A highly flamboyant, self-absorbed tiger tabaxi sorcerer who values fey aesthetics and unstable wild magic surges above all.
characters.quote: Darling, my fur is worth more than this entire village.

characters.name: Chuckles the Clown
characters.background: A malignant, dark fey spirit of a clown who was punched to death by Gideon Coal and now haunts him as a poltergeist.
characters.quote: Would you like a balloon? They're filled with my last breaths!

characters.name: Rodek Stonehearth
characters.background: The stout dwarven forge cleric of the Prime era. Rodek loves heavy hammers, fine ironworks, and stout ale.
characters.quote: A dwarf is only as good as the steel in his hand and the ale in his cup.

characters.name: Vandrys Truestrike
characters.background: A lethal elven archer and scout who maps the shifting borders of Prime.
characters.quote: An arrow speaks louder than words when negotiations fail.

characters.name: Anulin
characters.background: An elven wizard conducting dimensional research into the planar fractures leaking fey magic.
characters.quote: The dimensional ley lines are cracking. We must seal them.

characters.name: Sylvie
characters.background: A halfling druid who heals continental root systems corrupted by ancient shadow leaks.
characters.quote: Listen to the moss. It remembers the worlds that came before.

characters.name: Bitsy
characters.background: A tiny field mouse who wields a sewing needle as a rapier and acts as a spy for the Critter Alliance.
characters.quote: I am small, but my rage is immeasurable!

characters.name: Grumley
characters.background: A big, lazy badger barbarian and cook who fights with a heavy iron frying pan to protect his friends.
characters.quote: A good nap is worth three gold coins.

characters.name: Hazel
characters.background: A quick-witted squirrel archer who defends the forest canopy from invading cat regiments.
characters.quote: One shot, one nut. Keep your eyes on the branches.

characters.name: Captain Pyke
characters.background: A gruff space bounty hunter who commands the starship Rhapsody through lawless galaxies.
characters.quote: The bounty is worth more if you're alive, but I don't mind taking a cut.

characters.name: Rett
characters.background: The hotshot ace pilot of the Rhapsody, known for executing impossible ship dogfight maneuvers.
characters.quote: Hold onto your seats. I'm going to make us fly through this black hole.

characters.name: Chuckles (Space Jester)
characters.background: A cloned jester carrying the digitized mind of the original Chuckles the Clown, causing galactic mischief.
characters.quote: Squeak! Gideon, you can't punch me in a vacuum!

characters.name: Vigilante Neon
characters.background: A cybernetically enhanced infiltrator in Megacity 9 who hacks corporate servers to expose Bloodfleet projects.
characters.quote: Corporate firewalls are made to be shattered.

characters.name: Bloodfleet Defector
characters.background: A former shock trooper of the Bloodfleet corporate navy who defected to the outer system resistance.
characters.quote: I fired my last shot for the corporation. Now I fire for the crew.

locations.name: Drakkar Frost Wastes
locations.description: A freezing, treacherous wasteland in northern Avantris where survivors fight blizzards and ice giants.

locations.name: Castle Ravenloft
locations.description: The gothic stronghold of Countess Strahdanya von Zarovich, looming high on a cliff over the Barovian valley.

locations.name: Death House
locations.description: A haunted, sanity-draining manor on the edge of the Barovian woods.

locations.name: Skyport Stryga
locations.description: A floating island harbor and sky-city that served as the center of aerial commerce before the great collapse.

locations.name: Saltmarsh Port
locations.description: A damp coastal port town infested with sea-devils, smugglers, and underwater cults.

locations.name: Druskenvald Streets
locations.description: Steam-filled cobblestone streets under a sky of eternal night, plagued by werewolves and corporate shadow operations.

locations.name: Skitterdeep Mine
locations.description: A haunted, deep underground mining complex where workers encountered ancient dark entities.

locations.name: Carnivàle Lecroux
locations.description: A colorful, slightly shady traveling circus caravan serving as a cover for magic scams.

locations.name: The Hither Swamps of Prismeer
locations.description: A soggy Feywild swamp ruled by the swamp-hag Bavlorna Blightstraw.

locations.name: Stonehearth Forge
locations.description: A massive, legendary dwarven mining and metalworking forge at the center of the Prime continent.

locations.name: The Deep Dimwood
locations.description: An ancient woodland plane populated by factions of warring animal vagabonds, cats, and crows.

locations.name: The Starship Rhapsody
locations.description: A retro-futurism space vessel piloted by Pyke and Rett, which serves as the crew's mobile base.

locations.name: Megacity 9
locations.description: A neon-drenched cyberpunk metropolis dominated by corporate guilds and scanner drones.

classes.name: Fighter
classes.description: Fighters are master combatants of weapons and battlefield tactics. In Avantris campaigns (like Once Upon a Witchlight), Gideon Coal represents the subclass of heavy frontline protection, combining pure physical force with tactical actions.

features.name: Action Surge
features.desc: Instantly regain 1 Main Action to use on the current combat turn (usable once per combat encounter).

features.name: Second Wind
features.desc: Regain 1d10 + Constitution modifier HP as a Bonus Action (usable once per combat).

classes.name: Rogue
classes.description: Rogues use stealth, precision strikes, and sneak attacks to outmaneuver opponents. Kremy Lispon represents the Arcane Trickster rogue, combining stealth tactics with arcane trickery and illusion magic.

features.name: Sneak Attack
features.desc: Deals +2d6 extra damage once per turn when attacking a target adjacent to another ally.

features.name: Cunning Action
features.desc: Allows player to Dash, Dodge, or Disengage as a Bonus Action instead of a Main Action.

classes.name: Fey Sorcerer / Wild Magic
classes.description: Sorcerers possess innate magic granted by planar bloodlines or Feywild exposure. Magic flows naturally, sometimes triggering chaotic Wild Magic Surges during spell casting.

features.name: Wild Magic Surge
features.desc: Rolls a d6 on spell cast to trigger a random chaotic effect (e.g. fire burst, healing, or disadvantage).

classes.name: Dryad Sentinel
classes.description: Dryad Sentinels are forest defenders who can call upon the woodland plane of the Deep Dimwood (like Peggy/Penny in Uprooted) to summon vines and roots.

features.name: Dryad Growth
features.desc: Summons vines that entrap an enemy, dealing 1d6 piercing damage and reducing their movement speed by 2 cells.

races.name: Human
races.description: Highly adaptable, found across all sea continents of Avantris.

races.name: Dryad
races.description: Nature spirits bound to ancient trees, prominent in the woodland spin-off Uprooted.

races.name: Cyborg
races.description: Constructed or enhanced humanoids found in Neon Odyssey.
